cues.en: Hello everyone and thank you so much for enrolling in this course.
cues.zh: 大家好，非常感謝你報名這門課。

cues.en: I'm so excited to help you on your journey to becoming a data scientist.
cues.zh: 很期待協助你踏上成為資料科學家的旅程。

cues.en: Before we get started I just wanted to let you know the best way to get help during the course if you ever have a question.
cues.zh: 開始之前，先告訴你在課程中遇到問題時，最好的求助方式。

cues.en: The first thing you should do is check the ethics you lecture and see if your questions answered there .
cues.zh: 首先，查看 FAQ 常見問題講座，看看是否已有解答。

cues.en: If it's not Next you should go ahead and search the Q&A forums using keywords pertaining to your question .
cues.zh: 如果沒有，再用與問題相關的關鍵字，搜尋問與答論壇。

cues.en: If you still can't find an answer Feel free to post the new questions to the Q&A forums with words and context that actually allow us to understand what you're asking.
cues.zh: 仍找不到答案的話，歡迎在問與答論壇發問，請用清楚的文字並提供上下文，讓我們了解你在問什麼。

cues.en: Thank you so much for enrolling in the course and I can't wait to get started.
cues.zh: 再次感謝報名，我已經迫不及待開始了。
